prompt: 解读某品牌最新 Pro/Pro Max/折叠屏发布会，重点分析影像，并做成网页。
expected_output: Current-source research plus an adaptive interactive HTML report.
assertions: Uses official specs for camera facts
Treats full reviews as higher-value than launch-day hands-on when available
Includes creator observations and separately labeled third-party interpretation
Uses tabs or navigation rather than an endless equal-card grid
Analyzes imaging technology and competitor implications

prompt: 做一份某 Android Ultra 旗舰的影像深度解读。
expected_output: Single-model camera analysis without forced multi-model or foldable sections.
assertions: Adapts structure to a single device
Covers optics, sensor, zoom, computational photography and video
Does not force a foldable interaction section

prompt: 发布会已经过去一周，把网页里的博主上手更新成完整测评。
expected_output: Refreshes creator evidence with newer full reviews and synthesis.
assertions: Captures review dates and test context
Adds what changed after full reviews
Separates third-party interpretations from creator conclusions
